_comment: Server definitions for the MCP Inspector CI smoke tests, passed via `--config`.
Inspector 2.0 cannot accept a stdio command whose arguments start with '-' on the
CLI (its target collection stops at the first dashed token), so the launch command
lives here instead. See docs/mcp-server-configuration.md upstream.
PATHS ARE RELATIVE TO THE REPOSITORY ROOT: the Inspector resolves --config against
the process cwd and spawns the server with that same cwd, and GitHub Actions runs
`run:` steps from $GITHUB_WORKSPACE. Invoke from the repo root, or add a per-server
